lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Reinforce adjective agreement with en and ett nouns.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Describing simple objects in the office or at home.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik look for or comment on everyday objects such as a cup, glass, table, chair, bag, or notebook, using simple adjectives.

main_focus.name: adjective agreement with en and ett
main_focus.description: Use the correct adjective form before or after common en and ett nouns.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use adjective-noun agreement naturally 4-6 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: simple questions with vilken and vad
basic definite forms: den här, det här

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use concrete office or home objects so agreement is tied to visible, practical nouns.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about or looks for an object.
dialogue_shape.middle: They describe several objects by color, size, or location.
dialogue_shape.ending: They find the object or agree which one they mean.

target_complexity.repetition: alternate en and ett examples without making the dialogue artificial

focus: which object the speakers are talking about
what color or size an object is
whether the object is an en or ett word through context

sentence_focus: one phrase with en plus adjective
one phrase with ett plus adjective
one sentence describing a table or glass
